title: Select-TTT: Query-Conditioned Selective Fast Weight Updates for In-Place Test-Time Training
abstract: arXiv:2610.36794v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Test-time training (TTT) enables a deployed language model to internalize incoming context on-the-fly into a small set of fast-weight parameters, rather than merely treating it as transient context for attention. In-Place TTT recently made this idea practical for large language models by repurposing the down-projection of standard MLP blocks as fast weights. However, we find that its benefit largely disappears on realistic web long-context question answering. We attribute this to In-Place TTT's uniform write schedule: every chunk is written with equal strength, so irrelevant content dilutes query-relevant information in fast-weight memory. Building on this insight, we propose Select-TTT, a model-agnostic, query-conditioned rule for In-Place TTT that scales each chunk's write strength by its relevance to the user query. This relevance signal requires no supervision and no new parameters: it is read directly from the model's frozen outpu

translated_title: Select-TTT：面向原位测试时训练的查询条件化选择性快权重更新
translated_abstract: 测试时训练（TTT）使部署后的语言模型能够将传入的上下文即时内化到一小组快权重参数中，而不仅仅是将其视为供注意力机制使用的瞬态上下文。原位TTT（In-Place TTT）最近通过将标准MLP块的下投影重新用作快权重，使这一思想在大型语言模型中变得实用。然而，我们发现其收益在真实的网页长上下文问答任务中基本消失。我们将此归因于原位TTT的统一写入调度：每个数据块都以相同强度写入，导致无关内容稀释了快权重记忆中与查询相关的信息。基于这一洞察，我们提出了Select-TTT，这是一种模型无关、查询条件化的原位TTT规则，它根据每个数据块与用户查询的相关性来缩放其写入强度。该相关性信号无需监督且无需新增参数：它直接从模型的冻结输出（此处摘要原文截断）中读取。
tldr: Select-TTT提出了一种模型无关的查询条件化规则，通过根据各数据块与用户查询的相关性来动态缩放其快权重写入强度，解决了原位测试时训练中统一写入调度导致无关内容稀释查询相关信息的问题。
en_tdlr: Select-TTT introduces a model-agnostic, query-conditioned rule for In-Place TTT that scales each chunk's fast-weight write strength by its relevance to the user query, solving the problem of query-relevant information being diluted by irrelevant content under uniform write schedules.
